name: Deadman's Beach Overlook
description: Look northwest across uninhabited Deadman's Beach. From summer into fall, sea turtles nest here. Enjoy this sensitive coastline from a respectful distance and never disturb nesting turtles, tracks or nests.

name: Canyon Overlook
description: Look down a beautiful coastal desert canyon that ends at the water. Seasonal changes bring different plants and wildlife.

name: Lighthouse Ridge Overlook
description: From the coastal ridge, look toward the Punta Chivato lighthouse and across the dramatic rocky shoreline of the Sea of Cortez.

name: Secret Beach and Naked Beach View
description: An elevated coastal view over Secret Beach and Naked Beach, where turquoise coves meet rugged desert headlands.

name: Naked and Secret Beach Panorama
description: Look down toward Naked Beach and Secret Beach, with the surrounding green desert canyon and distant mountain skyline.
